objectives.text: Your dice add up to an even number in total.
A straight of 3: any 3 numbers in a row, starting from any number (for example 4-5-6).
A straight of 4: any 4 numbers in a row, starting from any number (for example 3-4-5-6).
A straight of 5: any 5 numbers in a row, starting from any number (for example 2-3-4-5-6).
A straight of 6: any 6 numbers in a row, starting from any number (for example 1-2-3-4-5-6).
A straight of 3 in one colour: 3 numbers in a row on dice of a single colour.
A straight of 4 in one colour: 4 numbers in a row on dice of a single colour.
Two pairs: two different numbers that each appear at least twice.
A full house: one number at least three times and another at least twice.

grey: The player with the grey die must have at least 1 die of each colour in play.
The player with the grey die must total at least 15 (grey die included).
The player with the grey die can’t have another die showing the same number as the grey die.
The player with the grey die can have at most 6 dice (grey die included).
The player with the grey die must have at least one other die showing the same number as the grey die.
The player with the grey die can’t have more than 3 dice of a single colour.

black: Remove your lowest die (the one with the fewest pips you have).

Remove a die of the colour you have most of.

actions: Add or subtract 1 to a die (never below 1 or above 6).
Flip a die to its opposite face (1↔6, 2↔5, 3↔4).
Remove a die: it goes back into the bag.
